name: Dow
tagline: Leading materials science company serving high-growth markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Le segment Packaging & Specialty Plastics represente environ la moitie des ventes de Dow et concentre l'essentiel de l'exposition au cycle du polyethylene. C'est le KPI qui pilote la trajectoire de l'entreprise et le plus suivi par les investisseurs.

kpis.signal: Volumes en baisse de 2% au T1-2026, demande industrielle atone prolongee.
Prix local en recul de 7% a/a au T1-2026, pression persistante sur le pouvoir de fixation des prix.

kpis.short: Currency impact on net sales year-over-year
kpis.signal: Le change ajoute 3% aux ventes au T1-2026, premier vent favorable notable depuis 2021.

kpis.short: Polyethylene integrated margin improvement in Q2 guidance
kpis.name_fr: Amelioration de marge integree polyethylene (guidance T2)
kpis.signal: 0,26 $/lb de gain de marge polyethylene mondial integre dans la guidance T2-2026, hausse de prix d'avril incluse, mai en upside potentiel.

kpis.short: Global ethylene/polyethylene supply offline or constrained
kpis.name_fr: Offre mondiale ethylene/polyethylene hors service ou contrainte
kpis.signal: Environ la moitie de l'offre mondiale d'ethylene et polyethylene hors service ou contrainte suite au conflit au Moyen-Orient, choc d'offre 3x superieur a la tempete Uri de 2021.

kpis.name_fr: Objectif EBITDA programme Transform to Outperform
kpis.signal: Au moins 2 Md$ d'amelioration d'EBITDA visee (deux tiers productivite, un tiers croissance), avec 400 M$ deja identifies sur les premieres transformations de sites.
Suppression de 4 500 postes dans le monde annoncee avec le programme Transform to Outperform, plus reduction des ressources tierces.

kpis.short: First site transformation run-rate EBITDA gain
kpis.name_fr: Gain EBITDA de la premiere transformation de site
kpis.signal: La premiere transformation de site a identifie environ 80 M$ d'amelioration d'EBITDA en rythme annuel, bien au-dela de la projection initiale.

kpis.short: Consecutive quarters of downstream silicones growth
kpis.name_fr: Trimestres consecutifs de croissance des silicones aval
kpis.signal: Septieme trimestre consecutif de croissance des silicones aval, portee par l'electronique et les applications grand public.
Monetisation strategique d'actifs d'infrastructure Gulf Coast pour ~2,4 Md USD, plus 540 M USD via l'option InfraPark exercee en aout 2025.
Nouveau jugement de juin 2025 condamnant Nova a verser 1,62 Md CAD (~1,2 Md USD) pour dommages jusqu'en juin 2018, gain contingent non encore comptabilise.
798 M USD de charges cumulees et suppression d'environ 1 500 postes, decides par le conseil le 27 janvier 2025.

kpis.name_fr: Objectif de reduction structurelle des couts
kpis.signal: Objectif de 1 Md USD de reduction structurelle des couts annonce au T1-2025 pour renforcer la flexibilite financiere.
Dividende trimestriel ramene a 0,35 USD par action (contre 0,70 auparavant), 459e dividende consecutif depuis 1912.

ai_positioning.summary: Dow s'appuie sur des systemes d'information incluant de l'IA embarquee pour supporter des operations sures et fiables.
evidence: Depend de systemes d'information incluant de l'IA embarquee pour soutenir des operations sures, efficaces et fiables
IA presentee comme technologie operationnelle embarquee plutot qu'axe strategique de communication

risks.title: Macroeconomic Recession
risks.score_rationale: Company explicitly references macroeconomic uncertainty and supply-demand dynamics as factors impacting sales across all segments and regions. 7% revenue decline demonstrates direct exposure to economic cycles. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Global Economic Considerations: The Company operates in a global, competitive environment which gives rise to". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Economic recession could further deteriorate sales and profitability, particularly given existing demand weakness

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in competitive markets with local price declines driven by supply-demand dynamics, indicating pricing pressure and margin compression risk (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Increased levels of competition have resulted in lower prices and lower sales volume, which have". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competitive market dynamics could erode market share and price realization

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company subject to environmental and safety regulations; no material regulatory violation disclosed but ongoing compliance costs represent operational risk (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "The Company’s global business operations also give rise to market risk exposure related to changes". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Regulatory changes could increase operational costs and constrain manufacturing flexibility

risks.title: Credit Rating Downgrade
risks.score_rationale: Company's financial leverage and declining earnings create risk of credit rating downgrade, which would increase borrowing costs and access constraints (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Adverse economic conditions, a contraction in the availability of credit in the marketplace, or changes". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Credit rating downgrade would increase cost of debt financing and limit financial flexibility

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Primary exposures to natural gas, crude oil, ethylene and propylene feedstocks create significant margin volatility that cannot always be hedged effectively (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "The Company’s global business operations also give rise to market risk exposure related to changes". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Commodity price fluctuations directly impact production costs and profitability

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company (through Union Carbide) faces ongoing asbestos litigation with 7,158 unresolved claims as of Dec 31, 2025, increasing from 5,813 in 2024 (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "CLIMATE CHANGE - RELATED RISKS Climate Change: Climate change-related risks and uncertainties, legal or regulatory". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Asbestos litigation and other legal proceedings could result in material financial liabilities and reputational damage

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Asbestos liabilities and environmental regulations create ongoing reputational exposure that could impact stakeholder confidence (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "CLIMATE CHANGE - RELATED RISKS Climate Change: Climate change-related risks and uncertainties, legal or regulatory". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reputational damage could affect customer relationships and investor confidence

company_description: Dow Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides various materials science solutions for packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, India, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The company operates through Packaging & Specialty Plastics, Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure, and Performance Materials & Coatings segments. The Packaging & Specialty Plastics segment provides ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, and aromatics products; and other ethylene derivatives, such as polyolefin elastomers, ethylene vinyl acetate, and ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber. The Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure segment offers polyurethanes, including propylene oxide, propylene glycol, and polyether polyols; aromatic isocyanates and fully formulated polyurethane systems; and chlor-alkali and vinyl comprising chlorine and caustic soda, ethylene dichloride, and vinyl chloride monomer; and construction chemicals consisting of cellulose ethers, redispersible latex powders, and acrylic emulsions, as well as coatings, adhesives, sealants, elastomers, and composites.
